main_body: Modern multi-storey office/campus building: a large flat rooftop seen from above (with AC units and a skylight) over a front facade of four window rows and a glass entrance
top_band: Pale lilac-grey speckled roof surface, rows ~1-19, with a lighter parapet/front-edge line at rows ~19-21; AC units and a blue skylight sit on it
evidence: Reading a column down the middle: the textured rooftop is a clearly horizontal surface that is lighter and carries objects on it (rows 1-19). A pale front-edge line follows at rows ~19-21, then a dark green band at row ~22 acting as the eave shadow. Below that is the vertical facade with its own shading, framed windows with sills and mullions, floor bands and a canopy over the glass door. The roof is a real surface, not a rim, and is much shorter than the facade. No receding side face. Windows are only mildly inset, but the roof, edge and eave read correctly.

style.evidence: The wall and roof carry speckle or grain, and the windows have frames, sills, glass tones and diagonal reflections, so there are about 5 lightness steps on the concrete and glass ramps. Outlines are mostly tinted dark purple-grey, with only a few near-black accents at the door frame and roof edge. There are no large flat fills; the wall bands have speckle. Density is a little lower than the reference's rich tile roofs and timber, but it would sit acceptably next to them.
